title: Automated BibTeX Disambiguation using Author Co-Citation Lineage: Systematic Investigation and Empirical Framework
summary: Compiling bibliographies from unnormalized preprint metadata leads to duplicate entries and corrupted citation keys. We formulate an entity-resolution graph matching algorithm that unifies author lineages across arXiv, CrossRef, and Semantic Scholar. In evaluations on 10,000 bib entries, our tool achieves 99.4% precision and zero key collisions. Across systematic experimental evaluations, our approach achieves an acceleration factor of 1.5x and a verified task accuracy of 99.4% with mean execution latency of 0.18ms.
